title: Conditional kappa >= 0.0031234 by composing shared updates and helper hubs
body:
Give a source-dependent informal proof of conditional kappa >= 0.0031234, a gain of 0.00000003943 over pinned PR5802's 0.00312336057. This is a modest improvement. It combines PR5802's three shared pending-update conversions with both protected blocks in updated PR5795, retaining PR5786's asynchronous hubs and PR5774's native copies. The finite hybrid is exactly defined by supplied source words and literal edit data; it has not been materialized or replayed in this contribution.

The new protected-trace proof uses the complete source/read/write support of twenty original roles. It identifies ten complementary changed fibres, six exact source additions and three COPY-frame exceptions. Every new native pair comes from one parent branch, with its retained exact phase and target matcher. Changed helper boundaries are disjoint. This proves the source-specific join rather than simply adding the parents' root values or assuming that old graph-node IDs remain valid.

Complete local paid profile: {1:2231,2:456,3:498,4:100,5:157,6:9,7:6}. Complete helper profile: {1:22,2:7,3:4,4:107,5:10,7:9,8:18,9:385}. The unchanged full p16/a7 caller has 13444 targets, 66906 paid calls and rank surplus 760; every local call, thin shear, whole idle, adapter and original target debit is retained. It has 28 owned labels, 30 lifetimes, peak 13 live owned fields and 25982 instructions. Owned buffers are never productive.

Against PR5802, the full differences are delta P=36(H1+H4-H5), delta T=36(-H1+H4+H5-H8). Elementary logarithm bounds and convexity of its complete old signed moment prove F_new(0.0031235)>227/25000. The actual two-block target transfer increases the productive moment and decreases the paid higher moment; both complete tail ratios stay below 125/128. Fresh reserve 1e-8, explicit finite completion/compiler constants and a huge sufficient H,N are supplied. All 54 strict outer rows and four functional conditions are proved by a new rational parameter family, using the retained admitted BIT .0034. No root or power sum was numerically evaluated.

Against the common hub source, the local gain is uniformly positive for every 0<t<1: 2[(2H5-H2-H8)+(2H7-H6-H8)]. These are two strict midpoint-concavity gaps. This is a complete tariff comparison, not automatic admission at arbitrary exponents.

Evidence: pure informal mathematics and literal source reading only. No constructor, scalar/native/phase/caller/invoice/price replay, solver, mathematical search or Lean run was executed. Parent operator identities and PR5802's positive tested certificate and weak tail bounds are explicit retained source premises. The same five native_all_columns, owned_erasure, compiler, precision_tape and analytic_recovery assumptions remain. There is no selected-frontier change, new raw root or optimality claim, materialized uniform word or rounded multiplier. Independent materialization and scientific validation are precise next tasks.

Source heads: PR5802 9bab1ca917ec4d1a4e60f4eb8c81d7ef92908a62; updated PR5795 206cb717c0c07737d61637b93f7502ca48850348; common PR5786 6b936acd68a7e0f9062037900f0fe9bc4b6fdd25; PR5796 4b30391e633ba0c7c674f03586ae97d443e9bc9c. Canonical main de5ec2e7a6074068452f45b1a191b5c72832df4a, priority 8. A final source read retained those heads and found PR5805's new G20 routing work, a separate component scope. Start with construction.md and shared-queries.md, then invoice.md and funding.md. Do not run an unchanged old constructor against a different schema or owned-label count. The new H is sufficient, not a claimed minimum.

Credit Ali Romman for the actual sum acquisitions, retained copies, asynchronous hubs and parent integration; Joel Pulikkan/GamingPuzzled for the R22 block; the released second-block author; flyingviper's helper interfaces; Pierre-Loic Doulcet/hexapode; Scratch-net; DreamingOfClouds; thu-nmrc; Chris R/Clear1nsight; Nick Petalas; Cinna Davis; David Arias; Gareth Davidson; Cao Yifan; zxv; Jacob Alan Sussman; and all retained P104/native/controller/compiler/phase/ownership/BIT/precision/analytic source notices. The parent notices are retained in NOTICES.md. The prior atlas is PR5803; this contribution supplies its concrete source composition and hand budget rather than another hypothetical atlas.

Twelve files: eight mathematical/source notes and four literal source-data objects. New text is Apache-2.0 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance from one coordinator and three workers. Only research/shared-updates-hub-composition is added. Publication-byte checks are separate from scientific evidence.
